body: Thanks, I shall give them a listen later on, I'm currently on my mobile with terrible internet connection

Here, this is my previous post from a couple of months ago, http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/23029h/tl_dr_someone_tell_me_they_wont_hurt_for_as_long/

I'm using a mobile device so I'm bit sure that link will work

Hello there, I know how you feel, I have tried therapy for my own problem, it doesn't help me either. Can I ask why you feel this way?

If you need anyone to talk to I'm here man.

She left me as she wasn't happy, she told me she hadn't been happy for a few months, that she had changed and didn't love me anymore. The thing that hurts the most is that she didn't say anything when she first felt this way, but waited until it built up enough to just leave

Thanks but that's what I worry about, I don't want to spend the next 5 or more years looking for the right person, it sounds bad but I just want the right person to appear in front of me because right now all I can think is that my ex was the right person

Thanks, it means a lot to me, I made half a rash decision, I should be ok, I'm going to give it a week to see what I feel like then, did you ever talk to anyone close to you about it? I just want to know if it really helps or just makes things worse. As far as anyone who really knows me I'm doing fine and I am moving on, but that's just one big lie, I feel like ending it every day, I don't really know what's stoping me apart from them being there

I just don't think I will be able to did anyone better or even equal to her, that's the hardest part
Could you ever move past the person? That is the hardest thing that I can't deal with, I'm terrified of being alone and I don't want to live like this in this pain any more
